parameters.query: SELECT $1::bigint AS chat_id, $2::text AS question, left(COALESCE(string_agg('• ' || message_text, E'\n' ORDER BY received_at DESC), '저장된 기억이 없습니다.'), 2000) AS memory_context FROM (SELECT message_text, received_at FROM telegram_memory WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND (message_text ILIKE '%' || $2::text || '%' OR received_at > now() - interval '7 days') ORDER BY (message_text ILIKE '%' || $2::text || '%') DESC, received_at DESC LIMIT 3) recent;

parameters.query: SELECT $1::bigint AS chat_id, $2::text AS keyword, COALESCE(string_agg('• ' || message_text, E'\n' ORDER BY received_at DESC), '검색 결과가 없습니다.') AS memories FROM (SELECT message_text, received_at FROM telegram_memory WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND message_text ILIKE '%' || $2::text || '%' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 10) matched;

SELECT $1::bigint AS chat_id, COALESCE(string_agg('• ' || message_text, E'\n' ORDER BY received_at DESC), '저장된 기억이 없습니다.') AS memories FROM (SELECT message_text, received_at FROM telegram_memory WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 5) recent;

INSERT INTO telegram_memory (update_id, chat_id, message_id, user_id, username, message_text, raw_update) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (update_id) DO UPDATE SET message_text = EXCLUDED.message_text RETURNING chat_id, message_text;

WITH p AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS chat_id, $2::bigint AS decision_id, $3::text AS new_status, $4::text AS note), updated AS (UPDATE approval_requests a SET status=p.new_status, decided_at=NOW(), decision_note=NULLIF(p.note,'') FROM p WHERE a.id=p.decision_id AND a.status='pending' AND p.new_status IN ('approved','deferred','rejected') RETURNING a.id,a.title,a.status,a.decision_note), existing AS (SELECT a.id,a.title,a.status,a.decision_note FROM approval_requests a,p WHERE a.id=p.decision_id) SELECT p.chat_id, CASE WHEN p.decision_id IS NULL OR p.new_status='invalid' THEN '명령 형식이 맞지 않습니다. 예: /승인 3 게시' WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.status='approved' THEN '✅ 승인 완료 #'||u.id||' · '||u.title||COALESCE(' · 선택: '||u.decision_note,'') WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.status='deferred' THEN '⏸ 보류 완료 #'||u.id||' · '||u.title WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.status='rejected' THEN '❌ 거절 완료 #'||u.id||' · '||u.title||COALESCE(' · 사유: '||u.decision_note,'') WHEN e.status='approved' THEN '✅ 이미 승인 완료 #'||e.id||' · '||e.title WHEN e.status='deferred' THEN '⏸ 이미 보류 완료 #'||e.id||' · '||e.title WHEN e.status='rejected' THEN '❌ 이미 거절 완료 #'||e.id||' · '||e.title ELSE '존재하지 않는 결정번호입니다: '||p.decision_id END AS response_text FROM p LEFT JOIN updated u ON TRUE LEFT JOIN existing e ON TRUE;

WITH i AS (SELECT $1::bigint chat_id, trim($2::text) step_key), expected AS (SELECT * FROM next_owner_onboarding_action), updated AS (UPDATE account_onboarding_steps s SET status='verified_done', verified_at=now(), evidence='Owner Telegram completion', updated_at=now() FROM i, expected e WHERE s.step_key=i.step_key AND s.step_key=e.step_key RETURNING s.step_key,s.step_name), next_step AS (SELECT step_key,step_name,owner_action FROM next_owner_onboarding_action) SELECT i.chat_id, CASE WHEN u.step_key IS NULL THEN '완료 처리하지 않았습니다. 현재 단계와 코드가 일치해야 합니다. 현재 코드: ' || COALESCE(e.step_key,'없음') WHEN n.step_key IS NULL THEN '✅ ' || u.step_name || ' 완료. 사용자가 직접 할 다음 인증 단계는 없습니다.' ELSE '✅ ' || u.step_name || E' 완료.

다음 단계 [' || n.step_key || E'] ' || n.step_name || E'
' || n.owner_action || E'

끝나면 /완료 ' || n.step_key END response_text FROM i LEFT JOIN expected e ON true LEFT JOIN updated u ON true LEFT JOIN next_step n ON true;

parameters.jsCode: const m=$json.message||{}; const text=String(m.text||'').trim(); const match=text.match(/^(?:\/)?(GOOD|BAD)(?:\s+(.+))?$/i)||text.match(/^수정\s*:\s*(.+)$/i); if(!match) return []; const action=(match[1]||'수정').toUpperCase(); const note=action==='수정'?(match[2]||match[1]||''):String(match[2]||''); return [{json:{chat_id:m.chat?.id,action,note,raw_text:text}}];

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, task_name FROM local_llm_runs WHERE status='complete' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), updated AS (UPDATE local_llm_runs r SET metadata=COALESCE(r.metadata,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('owner_review',$1::text,'owner_note',$2::text,'reviewed_at',now()) WHERE r.id=(SELECT id FROM latest) RETURNING r.id,r.task_name,r.metadata->>'owner_review' AS review) SELECT $3::bigint AS chat_id, CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN '검토할 완료 결과가 없습니다.' ELSE '✅ 검토 기록 완료 #'||u.id||E'
작업: '||u.task_name||E'
판정: '||u.review||COALESCE(E'
메모: '||NULLIF($2::text,''),'')||E'

현재는 승인 기록만 저장했습니다. 외부 게시·결제는 별도 승인 게이트에서 처리합니다.' END AS response_text FROM updated u;
